# pvecli backup status

Backup coverage of each guest: covering job, last backup, last run.

With --older-than and --failed together, guests with either problem
are shown.

```text
pvecli backup status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--older-than VALUE` | Only guests whose last backup is older (2d, 12h, 1w) or missing. |
| `--failed` | Only guests whose last backup run failed. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile(s): name, list, pattern ('client-*') or @group. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli backup status
pvecli backup status --older-than 2d --failed -p '*'
```
